brand.title: NeuroNest : Personalized Cognitive Care.
brand.tagline: Train the Mind. Support Memory. Empower Everyday Life.
brand.subtitle: AI-powered personalized cognitive gaming and memory assistance for elderly dementia patients.
brand.description: NeuroNest helps elderly users strengthen memory, attention, recall and daily-life cognitive skills through personalized games, real-world activities, AI recommendations and caregiver support.
brand.disclaimer: NeuroNest supports cognitive wellness, memory assistance and activity tracking. It does not diagnose dementia or replace professional medical care.

dashboard.subGreeting: Let's keep your mind active today.

games.title: Cognitive Gaming Suite
games.subtitle: Five clinically structured games tailored for elderly memory stimulation and adaptive neuroplasticity.
games.memoryMatchDesc: Pair familiar everyday objects (Keys, Glasses, Cup, Book) to exercise visual working memory.
games.objectRecallDesc: Inspect familiar items for a few seconds, then identify which objects were presented.
games.sequenceRecallDesc: Arrange daily life routines (Morning Tea, Medicine Routine, Breakfast) in chronological order.
games.patternMemoryDesc: Memorize and reproduce illuminated spatial grid patterns to stimulate focus.
games.wordAssociationDesc: Link related everyday words and life concepts to reinforce semantic neural connections.

memoryCompanion.title: Memory Companion
memoryCompanion.subtitle: Your gentle assistant for remembering daily routines, dear family members, important places, and medication schedules.
